title: Section 148A — Right to lodge a caveat — CPC 1908

content.heading: Right to lodge a caveat
content.text: Where an application is expected to be made, or has been made, in a suit or proceeding instituted, or about to be instituted, in a Court, any person claiming a right to appear before the Court on the hearing of such application may lodge a caveat in respect thereof. The Court shall serve notice of the application on the caveator. A caveat shall not remain in force after ninety days.
